title: Intel announces a $15B common stock offering, with proceeds going to general corporate purposes like "maintaining a strong balance sheet"; INTC falls 3%+ (Sarah Frier/Bloomberg)
summary: Sarah Frier / Bloomberg: Intel announces a $15B common stock offering, with proceeds going to general corporate purposes like “maintaining a strong balance sheet”; INTC falls 3%+ — Intel Corp. said it will be offering $15 billion in common stock, taking advantage of renewed interest in its business prospects during …
